title: Knicks Game at Madison Square Garden
content: There are so many things in motion on and off the court in an NBA game that it kind of boggles the mind to translate it into paint.(link to video on Facebook) As you can see in the video, I try to use the brush systematically to paint similar objects with a given paint mixture, so I'm not mixing and painting every spot.Here again, I'm starting the sketch from life and finishing it later from a variety of references, including photos and videos. Even playing a sound recording of the game gets my head back into my memories.Knicks game, Madison Square Garden, gouacheWith a vignette like this I wanted to gradate the picture to the white of the page at the edges. I arbitrarily lightened it with cool colors on the right and warm colors on the left.-----Check out the whole blog series:1.Report from the Court: Audio Production2.My Assignment: ESPN Sports Reporter3.ESPN Commentator Stephen A.
